summary: Los Alamos Lookout: 1948 security tower at a lab gate, used by Los Alamos firefighters for detection until the 1980s; NHLR-registered 2023; listed standing.

notes_for_editor: Built 1948 and identity are well supported (register, Zinn, LANL). Disputed: (1) Closure: Zinn's overview says the tower closed 'during the 1970s'; Trehern's account has it staffed in the 1970s and not used for detection by 1981-1987. Story reports both. The 1987 event year is the end of Trehern's tenure, not a single date. (2) Location: register says the former Main Gate; Zinn says the agreement's 'main entrance' and an 'east entrance' figure caption; LANL says East Gate. Probably the same gate under different names, not confirmed. (3) Who ran the 1944-1948 structure: register says jointly AEC and Forest Service; Zinn describes an AEC security tower whose duties the Los Alamos Fire Department handled. (4) Owner: register says 'Administered by Los Alamos County' (checked 2026-10-09). The record's kind 'tower' versus FFLA's 'Security Tower' (non-wildland list) is a possible kind note, not an error. A LA Daily Post item on current maintenance returned HTTP 429 and was not read or cited. Access rated restricted by inference; no visiting rules found. Zinn's caption for the figure is split across columns, so the east-entrance wording is cited from Zinn's own text and the LANL post.
